'''Lila Rawlkiss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] who did business out of the [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lila Rawlkiss was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
